data.title: About bookings and payments.
items: Can I approve each guest myself?
Yes. Turn on applications, ask your questions, and approve or decline each person. Approved guests pay to confirm their place.
Yes. Guests pay by UPI or card at booking, through Razorpay. Every payment is matched to the right name.
Refunds follow the cancellation policy you set for the event. If there is a waitlist, the next person gets an offer for the place.
Can an event stay off public pages?
Yes. Make it invite-only and share a private link, or send one person a private offer with their own checkout.
Can the price change as the event fills?
Yes, if you turn on dynamic pricing: the price steps up by an amount you set as places fill, up to a maximum you choose.
Can I bring bookings from another tool?
Yes. Import your guest list from any tool and take new bookings on Catch whenever you’re ready.
